description: This file contains the definition of an interface and a class for managing leases in a Orleans stream provider context. It facilitates acquiring, renewing, and releasing stream queue leases, as well as tracking responsibility mappings for testing.

classes.name: ILeaseManagerGrain
classes.description: Interface defining lease management operations for stream provider grains, including acquiring, renewing, releasing leases, and responsibility tracking.

classes.name: LeaseManagerGrain
classes.description: Implementation of the lease management logic, managing queue leases, and responsibility mappings within the Orleans framework.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Initializes the lease manager grain's dependencies and internal state upon activation.

methods.name: GetLeaseResposibility
methods.description: Calculates and returns the number of leases responsibility per silo.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Finds and assigns an unassigned lease, updating its renewal time.

methods.name: Renew
methods.description: Renews the lease of a given queue if it exists.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Releases a lease by marking it as unassigned.

methods.name: SetQueuesAsLeases
methods.description: Initializes the lease map with a set of queue IDs.

methods.name: RecordBalancerResponsibility
methods.description: Records the responsibility count for a balancer, used for testing assertions.

methods.name: GetResponsibilityMap
methods.description: Returns the current responsibility map of balancers to queue counts.
